content.name: Jana Becker
content.title: Teacher of English and History (Gymnasium, Zweites Staatsexamen)
content.summary: Fully qualified secondary teacher for English and History who completed my Referendariat at a Berlin Gymnasium in 2025 and now teaches at a bilingual international school. Experienced with mixed-ability classes, CLIL history lessons in English and preparing Year 10 students for the MSA.

experience.title: Lehramtsanwärterin / Studienreferendarin (Trainee Teacher)
bullets: Taught English and History in Years 7–12 for 18 months, including about 7 lessons a week of independent teaching, under the supervision of seminar leaders.
Designed a bilingual (CLIL) history unit on the Cold War in Berlin, later used by two colleagues.
Passed the Zweites Staatsexamen with an overall grade of 1.7, including two assessed demonstration lessons.
Organised a school exchange with a partner school in Leeds for 22 Year 9 students.

experience.title: Teacher of English and History
bullets: Teach 6 classes from Grade 7 to Grade 10, around 140 students, in a bilingual German-English school.
Prepare Grade 10 students for the English exam of the Mittlerer Schulabschluss (MSA); my class's mock average improved from 2.9 to 2.3.
Introduced a reading log and class library that raised the number of English books read per student from 2 to 6 in a term.
